description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter front-end application. It defines the main app widget and a home page widget that displays a loading indicator, indicating that the app is in a generation or initialization phase.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: The root widget of the application, sets up the MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the home page with a title.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state class managing the build method for MyHomePage, displaying a scaffold with an app bar and centered loading content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point for the Flutter app, calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp, MyHomePage, and _MyHomePageState.
